info.title: hermes-studiotwin dashboard API v1 (frozen, S03)
info.description: DESIGN §5 routes mounted by pinned core under /api/plugins/hermes-studiotwin. Every route is nonbilling: the backend never authorizes, consents or dispatches.

get.description: Exactly one path or handle required, otherwise INVALID_PARAMS. Handle is scope/generation/purpose/read-count/expiry-bound and resolves only backend-side; foreign scope returns not-found. Both flows require the full open/fstat sandbox before streaming. Never derive backend paths from asset URLs.

post.summary: Bounded local model statistics (processor script from S17).
Blender handoff preflight only (planner script from S17); no execution.
Classified local preview from the gateway; never authorizes or dispatches.

get.description: S15 maps opaque, scope/generation-bound local cursors to upstream offset pagination. Fetch limit+1 (or a bounded lookahead) to establish hasMore; never infer a total. Cursors expire on scope generation change; foreign/expired cursors return not-found. Concurrent upstream changes may shift pages; deduplicate by Concept ID without inventing snapshot revisions.
get.x-studiotwin-origin: S03 addition: §5 lists no Concept read route; S15 owns dashboard/services/concepts.py and the gateway allowlist (§7.3) includes Concept get/status.

get.description: History is a bounded local window over mediated upstream asset/operation history. It preserves pending/failed attempts with null assetId. Missing timestamps sort first, then createdAt ascending, preserving upstream order on ties. S15 checks active markers against activeAssetId, sourceConceptId ownership/visibility, and generation-bound history cursors. An absent revision is null, never a fabricated zero. No arbitrary server metadata is forwarded.

post.description: S11 authenticates dashboard session and current scope/generation, then IPC to S10. scopeId is an equality assertion, not selected authority: foreign scope returns not-found. Atomically compare operationId to the current verified-overrun pause to refuse stale acknowledgement of a newer pause. Repeat of the same acknowledgement returns its original timestamp; absent/mismatched pause is not-found. Only acknowledged_at_ms changes; settlement/reservation/evidence/authorization and dispatch count remain unchanged. Fresh paid work still requires a new preview and once-only host consent. S10 and S11 must test this against their actual stores and dispatcher spies.

MediatedTextV1.description: Text that has passed the S06/S07 result-mediation boundary (D20). Never carries a URL, storage URI, presigned field, query string or credential.

LocalPathV1.description: Absolute POSIX or slash-normalized Windows drive path; hidden ancestors and spaces supported. Syntax only: verify current scope/generation and approved root, resolve(strict=True), open and fstat before reading; reject symlink escape, wrong owner/permissions, nonregular file, disallowed extension/MIME and size overflow. Never percent-decode this path.

IncompatibleContractV1.description: 412 refusal: the request named another contract version. Never a best-effort guess.

StatusV1.description: Never carries the key or any credential value.

createdAtRaw.description: Optional safe raw timestamp fallback. S12 preserves only mediated display text; absent means unavailable, not zero epoch.

contentRoute.description: The only renderer-visible media location (§5 secret boundary).

AssetPageV1.description: offset/limit are local windowing over the full scoped list; the server tool has no cursor.

submittedAtRaw.description: Optional mediated raw timestamp fallback for S14; never forward raw diagnostics.

UploadCreatedV1.description: Plugin-local opaque upload ID. StudioTwin presigned fields never leave backend memory (D09).

LineageV1.description: Bounded DAG: at most 100 nodes, depth 12.

LocalAudioConvertRequestV1.description: Exactly one source: remote Desktop sends an asset/variant ID or opaque scoped handle. sourcePath is legacy local-only input and still requires full sandbox proof; never guess it from contentRoute. ProcessorSourceV1 obligations apply to every source before reading.

LocalEnvPreviewRequestV1.description: Exactly one source: remote Desktop sends an asset/variant ID or opaque scoped handle. sourcePath is legacy local-only input and still requires full sandbox proof; never guess it from contentRoute. ProcessorSourceV1 obligations apply to every source before reading.

LocalModelStatsRequestV1.description: Exactly one source: remote Desktop sends an asset/variant ID or opaque scoped handle. sourcePath is legacy local-only input and still requires full sandbox proof; never guess it from contentRoute. ProcessorSourceV1 obligations apply to every source before reading.

BlenderPlanRequestV1.description: Exactly one source: remote Desktop sends an asset/variant ID or opaque scoped handle. sourcePath is legacy local-only input and still requires full sandbox proof; never guess it from contentRoute. ProcessorSourceV1 obligations apply to every source before reading.

BlenderPlanV1.description: Preflight only. Execution is a separate consented action outside this contract.

QuoteRequestV1.description: Raw candidate request, never reflected as mediated output. Before forwarding to IPC, quoting or logging, call gateway.redaction.validate_candidate_inputs_v1 with current exact classified tool/schemaHash and sensitive-value registry; then S09 canonicalizes effective inputs. Browser scope/authentication is not paid consent.

maxCredits.description: Maximum enforced by the authenticated server's verified conditional submission contract, not the local estimate. Never present in interim-local.

observedAtMs.description: Timestamp of the price observation, not browser receipt. Omitted/null means freshness unknown; never show a fresh estimate.

QuotePreviewV1.description: A classified local preview. Never authorizes or dispatches; consent only via the MCP elicitation round trip (§5.3). estimatedCredits remains an estimate in both modes. maxCredits is a distinct server-mode bound, required only in server-max-credits and forbidden in interim-local. S10 must verify authenticated paidSubmissionMaxCreditsV1 proof before emitting server mode; labels are not capability proof. Interim execution additionally requires Victor's risk acceptance and D24/D31. observedAtMs (when supplied) is the estimate observation time, not a guaranteed price; S10/S23 must check observation <= expiry and freshness before displaying a fresh estimate.

OperationStateV1.description: S10/S14 may present ambiguous candidates before any jobId is known. Read-only; no candidate selection or recovery action can authorize re-dispatch.

ConceptHistoryEntryV1.description: Safe timeline metadata only. Upload operations normalize to attach. Unknown kind/state stays unknown. A null assetId is legitimate for pending and retained unsuccessful operations; never invent an asset. Raw times are bounded mediated text, never raw diagnostics. S15 checks chronological and active-asset relations at runtime.

revision.description: Only a server-supplied revision; null when not supplied. Never infer a revision from timestamps or list order.

sourceConceptId.description: Verified visible same-scope fork origin, or null if unavailable. Not proof that the source still exists.

ToolInputSchemaResponseV1.description: Returned only after S08 verifies exact live tool name/schemaHash against release classification. Hash is SHA256 of canonical {name,inputSchema,outputSchema} with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=True (S02 catalog.schema_hash). It identifies upstream shape, not the lossy mediated projection and is not authority alone. Authenticated IPC and current scope/generation bind this response. S23 compares tool/schemaHash to current capability entry; invalidate on reconnect/drift. Unknown/drifted schemas return unavailable, remain visible in capabilities as disabled, and do not receive executable form schemas.

RecoveryCandidatesV1.description: S14 read-only ambiguous-call presentation. not-visible means UNKNOWN_NOT_VISIBLE, not unbilled. Multiple candidates remain unresolved and reservation held; no UI selection authorizes a retry. S10 verifies exactly one candidate by time/function/canonical fingerprint and same-scope ownership before binding a matched ID. Candidate times can be unavailable; never invent a zero epoch. No route in this type dispatches.
